texts.title: At the tourist office
texts.body:
Maryam: Good morning. I would like to book the mountain tour for my family.
Salim: Of course. The tour leaves at 8:30 every morning from the city centre.
Maryam: How much does it cost for each person?
Salim: It is 12 rials for adults, and children under ten are free.
Maryam: Good. We are five people. What is the name of the guide?
Salim: His name is Mr Bryant. I will spell it: B-R-Y-A-N-T.
Maryam: Thank you. Do we need to bring food?
Salim: No, lunch is included, but you should bring warm clothes because it is cold in the mountains.

texts.title: A talk about frankincense
texts.body: Good afternoon, everyone. Today I will talk about frankincense in Dhofar. Frankincense comes from a small tree that grows in dry valleys. Farmers cut the tree in April. After two weeks, they collect the white drops. The best frankincense is called Hojari. In the past, ships carried it to India and Rome. Today, about 7000 tourists visit the frankincense museum every month. The museum opens at 9:00 and closes at 6:00.
